subject: Request: extend sandbox access — integration pipeline lag at LedgerFox
messages:
From: Tom Harrington <tom.h@ledgerfox.com>
To: ava.chen@redwood.com
Cc: procure@ledgerfox.com
Date: Thu, 18 Sep 2025 08:32:14 -0700
Subject: Sandbox access — can we get an extension?

Hi Ava,

Quick note from our engineering team: the connector work for LedgerFox's payments data source hit an unexpected pagination/refresh issue when we started higher-volume testing. We're blocked on partnering with our infra team to get the vendor-side fix in place; that will take ~2 more weeks.

We were hoping Redwood could extend our sandbox access and top up credits so we don't lose the progress on evaluation — ideally an additional 30 days and a buffer of tokens for a larger test window. Procurement is looped in for any formal paperwork.

Attachment: integration_logs.zip (snippet of failing requests)

Appreciate any flexibility here — we're excited about the performance you've shown so far and want to avoid a restart.

Best,
Tom
Tom Harrington
Head of Platform Engineering, LedgerFox
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Tom Harrington <tom.h@ledgerfox.com>
Cc: procure@ledgerfox.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 18 Sep 2025 10:05:02 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sandbox access — can we get an extension?

Hi Tom — thanks for the heads up and for sending the logs.

We're glad LedgerFox is progressing into larger-scale tests. I can start by provisioning a 30-day extension and escalating the credit top-up request to our sales manager. To move quickly, could you confirm the approximate token volume you'd expect to run over the extended window (ballpark is fine) and whether you need any private networking tweaks?

I'll coordinate the paperwork with procurement as needed. Marcus (cc'd) from our solutions team can also triage the logs with you if you'd like a joint troubleshooting session.

Next steps:
- Tom: quick estimate of token usage
- Ava: request credit top-up and extension (escalate if required)
- Marcus: offer a technical sync

Cheers,
Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0189
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 18 Sep 2025 10:18:37 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Sandbox access — LedgerFox asks for 30-day extension + credits

Marissa / Marcus — forwarding LedgerFox's request. Key points:
- They hit a pagination/refresh blocker during scale tests; vendor fix will take ~2 weeks.
- Customer wants 30 extra days and a token buffer for the extended test. They did not give an exact token estimate in the logs email; Tom will follow up with a ballpark.

I recommend: 30-day extension + 75k token sandbox credit as a standard "runway" to keep the POC warm. If they need more, we can escalate for additional credits tied to a short SOW for joint debugging (Marcus to lead).

I've attached the logs the customer sent (integration_logs.zip). If you approve, I'll confirm with LedgerFox and create a HubSpot activity and the SOW draft.

(attachment: integration_logs.zip)

Thanks — Ava
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Sep 2025 09:14:05 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Sandbox access — LedgerFox asks for 30-day extension + credits

Ava — good write-up. Approve 30-day extension + 75,000 token credit from our sandbox pool as a discretionary gesture to keep momentum. For anything beyond 75k tokens, I need a one-pager SOW and manager sign-off. Marcus, please confirm availability for a 60-minute troubleshooting session next week; if it looks like a sustained engineering engagement, we'll route a compensated SOW.

I drafted a short SOW skeleton and attached it for your reference: SOW_draft.pdf. If Ava wants to offer a partial paid troubleshooting engagement instead of larger free credits, note that as an option in the HubSpot notes.

(attachment: SOW_draft.pdf)

Marissa Cole
Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Tom Harrington <tom.h@ledgerfox.com>
Cc: procure@ledgerfox.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 25 Sep 2025 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sandbox access — can we get an extension?

Hi Tom — quick update and confirmation.

Good news: we've approved a 30-day sandbox extension plus a 75,000 token credit top-up to keep your evaluation moving. That top-up is already queued on our side and will be visible in your console within the next business day.

Next steps:
- Marcus (cc) will reach out directly to schedule a 60-minute troubleshooting session next week to review the logs and validate the pagination behavior.
- If LedgerFox ends up needing more tokens for an extended test window, we'll discuss a short SOW (Marissa attached a draft) and can propose a compensated debugging engagement.
- I'm creating a HubSpot activity for this thread: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/ledgerfox — please add any notes there for procurement.

Thanks for flagging this early — happy to help keep things moving.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0189
